title: MEWP Daily / Pre-Use Inspection
name: MEWP Daily / Pre-Use Inspection
description: Daily pre-use inspection for mobile elevating work platforms before operation. It records obvious defects and does not replace statutory examination or maintenance requirements.

sections.title: GENERAL CONDITION
items: Tyres / wheels / tracks are in serviceable condition
Structure, platform, guardrails and gates are secure and undamaged
No obvious hydraulic, fuel or battery leaks are present
Labels, load markings and safety decals are legible
Pins, fasteners, covers and access panels are secure
Machine is free from debris or damage that could affect safe operation

sections.title: CONTROLS AND SAFETY DEVICES
items: Ground and platform controls function correctly
Emergency lowering / auxiliary controls are available and understood
Horn / alarms / warning devices function where fitted
Interlocks, limit devices and gates operate correctly
Steering, drive and braking controls respond normally

sections.title: FLUIDS / POWER / DOCUMENTATION
items: Fuel / charge / battery condition is adequate
Hydraulic / coolant / other required levels appear satisfactory
Required inspection / examination status is current
Operator manual / emergency information is available where required
